The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the logic for risk-weighted availability metrics is sound.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across all trials with zero exceptions recorded. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully in 0.436 seconds using pytest version 8.4.1. While the verifier reward is 1.0, the judge reward of 0.66 suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling beyond the core functional requirements.
